### [SQL and Database Design Projects](posts/sql/index.html)

Designed and implemented relational database solutions using Oracle SQL, including ERD modelling, normalisation, schema creation, data population, DML transactions, reporting queries, and JSON/MongoDB query outputs.

### [Election Data Analysis Project](posts/Election/index.html)

Analysed Australian election data to explore changes in voter support for independent candidates, using visualisation and geographic analysis to communicate voting pattern changes.
:::

::: {.project-card}
### [Time Series Forecasting Project](posts/Bus_Fore/index.html)

Forecasted NSW household goods retail turnover using benchmark, ETS, and ARIMA models, with train/test evaluation, residual diagnostics, post-COVID data updates, and 24-month forecast interpretation.
:::

::: {.project-card}
### [Australian Time Use Data Analysis](posts/time-use/index.html)

Analysed Australian time-use survey data to explore leisure, social interaction, gender differences, and generational patterns using data cleaning, visualisation, uncertainty measures, and historical comparison.
:::

::: {.project-card}

A data storytelling article explaining nonlinear nitrate relationships across diverse watersheds.
